1,050 likes, 124 comments - ramit on October 14, 2026: "You do not need to have your financial life figured out by 30…but your 20s are a great time to start getting a few important things right.

Pay off your high-interest debt.
Start investing, even if it’s a small amount.
Learn how to earn more.
Figure out what your Rich Life actually looks like.

You don’t have to do all 9 of these perfectly. Just start. The earlier you do, the more time you give yourself and your money to grow.

Comment DECADE and I’ll send you my free Decade Net Worth Checklist so you can see what to focus on in your 20s, 30s, 40s, and beyond.".
